[[National Democratic Alliance (India)|National Democratic Alliance]] is an Indian political party coalition led by [[Bharatiya Janata Party]].
For the '''[[2009 Indian general election]], the [[National Democratic Alliance (India)|NDA]]'s candidates for the ''[[Lok Sabha]]'' [[List of Constituencies of the Lok Sabha|constituencies]]''' are as follows.
